recentItems.title: AP కి మళ్ళీ తుఫాను గండం! | Aquan cyclone alert | AP weather update 2026 | iDream
recentItems.description:
#AndhraPradesh, #CycloneAlert, #AquanCyclone, #APWeather, #BayOfBengal, #iDreamNews, #APFloods, #TeluguNews, #WeatherUpdate, #CoastalAndhra,
AP కి మళ్ళీ తుఫాను గండం! | Aquan cyclone alert | AP weather update 2026 | iDream 


Repeated Cyclone Impacts: Andhra Pradesh's coastal districts have been severely battered recently by consecutive cyclones like Arnab and Murasu, leaving residents shaken and infrastructure devastated.

New Cyclone Alert ("Aquan"): Meteorological departments indicate that a new weather system / low-pressure area is likely to form in the Bay of Bengal between November 9 and November 15, threatening to intensify into a severe cyclone named "Aquan."

Expected Path and Affected Regions: If the system strengthens into a cyclone, it is projected to move towards Nellore, Tirupati, and northern Tamil Nadu, potentially bringing heavy to very heavy rains across coastal Andhra and Rayalaseema districts.

Massive Financial and Material Loss: Previous cyclones caused extensive damages—including uprooted 100-to-150-year-old trees, broken electricity poles (with 1,000 poles specially sourced from Chennai), destroyed crops, and preliminary government estimates peg the total losses at around ₹1,200 crores.

Government Preparedness and Relief: Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu and Union Home Minister Amit Shah reviewed the situation, and local administrative machinery remains on high alert to evacuate low-lying areas, assist fishermen, and ensure zero loss of human life.

Uncertainty and Waiting Period: Weather officials note that while conditions favor a system formation, it could either dissipate or intensify, with complete clarity expected within the next couple of days.
